components.name: Navigation Bar
components.summary: A title with a Back button that reports taps.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A switch: tap to turn it on or off. The knob slides and the track fills with the tint.

components.name: List Row
components.summary: A table row with a title, optional detail and chevron. It highlights while pressed and reports taps.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.summary: A row of choices, one selected. Give it a comma-separated list; it makes a segment for each.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Drag to choose a value from 0 to 1. It stretches to whatever width you give it.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Minus and plus buttons that count down and up.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A filled button that dims while pressed and reports taps.

components.name: Tab Bar
components.summary: Tabs with a symbol and a title each; tapping one selects it. Give it comma-separated titles and symbol names.

nodes.name: Percent
